collection.title: Peugeot 307 SW Estate 2004 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Peugeot 307 SW 2004 to 2008 model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 26" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 307, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
